summary: 13 features and 3 fixes across HagiCode-org/web, HagiCode-org/hagicode-core.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: add DeepSeek secondary profession support (80db1ed)
  • executor: add DeepSeek executor type support (a4874bd)
  • theme: add theme preview CSS utilities for all themes (2aa2ebd)
  • theme: redesign preview cards with mini app skeleton layout (b9136e2)
  • ui-master: add remote command support for submit action (5b5394e)
  • research: add remote command support for submit action (2710ce5)
  • conversation: add ConversationModeSwitch component with color-coded styling (c7a8491)
  • theme: extract ThemeSelectionPanel and remove unused UI elements (fd921b9)
  • hero: apply profession filter to assigned heroes and fix color styling (acf151e)
  • executor: add Pi badge color scheme and test coverage (4ebaaa0)
  • statusbar: add Reasonix channel support (44ee506)
  • types: add Pi and DeepAgents executor avatar support (5e45ed2)
  • hero: add color support for Pi and Reasonix executors (3485213)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • pi: treat thinking snapshots as ordinary content (8bbfc29)
  • reasonix: preserve whitespace-only chunks in streaming responses (1a46e7f)

HagiCode-org/web

  • layout: ensure theme-aware colors in layout switcher options (7122cd9)
